lines.text: A man in the crowd asks Jesus to tell his brother to pay back what he borrowed, but Jesus refuses to judge between them.
Jesus warns them to guard against every form of greed, because life does not consist in abundance of possessions.
A rich man's ground produces an abundance, and he has nowhere to store his crops.
He plans to sell his grain and tell himself to take it easy, eat, drink, and be merry.

wrong_details.true: tear down his barns and build bigger ones to store his grain and goods

lines.text: God calls him a fool, says his life will be required that night, and Jesus warns about not being rich toward God.
